pages.title: Room to Grow
pages.text: Dress a Lattice with supported foliage and fill an Urn with dirt.

pages.title: Room to Grow
pages.text: Use reversible planted decorations; lattices and supports help furnish a courtyard or greenhouse.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Shears clear the lattice; a shovel empties the urn. These reversible decorations do not pretend the urn is a crop farm.

pages.title: How to use it
pages.text: Season HUD displays canonical time/season and distinct inactive state; it creates no second calendar and does not prove a particular crop fertile.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Collect leaf piles using Shears or Silk Touch; stack a full block and shear it for leaves. Recover decoration; tall conifer/deciduous piles form Podzol/Humus beneath.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Shovel sandy blocks or apply sand to compatible stone. Recover sand layers; water over supported sandstone with room beneath can generate falling sand piles.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Harvest mature crops and control nearby tall grass/sky exposure when tending farmland. Native weeds and biome-specific vegetation regrowth are configurable; 1.20.1 Mulch/Nulch are decorative, unlike their 1.19 farming behavior.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Use an empty Glass Bottle on hydrated Fluvisol or Silt. Collect Pond Water; cold and dry biomes instead supply Cryosol/Permafrost and Vertisol/Cracked Mud.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Use flint on grass/dirt, a shovel on a lit campfire, or plant Nether Wart on supported wart blocks. Obtain coarse ground or ash and use the expanded planting surfaces; Feather Falling prevents landing trampling.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Apply leaves or another supported plant to a lattice; use shears to clear it. Dress and clear the lattice's planted surface.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Use dirt on an Urn, then a shovel to remove it. Switch between filled and empty urn decoration.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Insert items into a supported decorated pot. Use the pot's backported storage behavior.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Native seasonal tags cover actual crops/seeds; underground/greenhouse/climate/dimension rules remain Serene Seasons-owned and ripe harvest stays available out of season.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Spawn sunflower keeps sun tracking; adapter checks seed production through native fertility. Denied growth can still consume bonemeal and already-ripe seeds remain harvestable.
